CanonAdditions: Blight-Touched entities possess a hive mind or shared instinct, demonstrated by synchronized movements.
Blight-Touched entities are capable of visible self-repair and regeneration of corrupted flesh.
Blight-Touched entities can temporarily be blinded or disoriented by intense magical light pulses.
The Blight fog interferes with Kaelen's magic flow, causing it to become erratic.
WorldStateUpdates: A courtyard exists within the old temple district, containing twisted vines with sickly luminescence and a ruined fountain filled with stagnant black water.
The main hall of the temple is located beyond the courtyard in the fog.

Updates: Elias Thorne exists and is an established character.

Elias Thorne remained outside the temple hall to cover Kaelen's retreat, facing the creatures alone.
Kaelen exists and is an established character.
Kaelen possesses a small crystalline vial containing condensed mana, which he used as an emergency reserve.
Kaelen sustained a grazing claw injury to his side that caused bleeding.
Kaelen entered the temple hall and disappeared into the darkness.
